entries.en: We've got a clean drop, Commander.

Stupid krogan. No wonder his kind ran themselves into the ground.

I thought we were almost done with krogan. What's it take to get rid of them?

Watch that krogan of yours. Who knows what he'll do once you're in the breeding chambers.

I don't even want to imagine what will happen if we don't destroy this facility.
I really hope the Council pays attention to what's happening here.
The captain has never let us down, and never will.

The krogan certainly are persistent. Not in a good way.

We can't let the krogan cancer spread again.
This mess will only get bigger. Unless we stop it.
